description: This file defines a validation rule class 'LeaveTypeIdRule' within the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin API. It extends an abstract validator class and uses a trait for leave type services. The core function validates if a given input corresponds to an existing LeaveType entity by querying the data access object.

classes.name: LeaveTypeIdRule
classes.description: Validation rule class that checks whether a given leave type ID corresponds to an existing LeaveType entity.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the provided input corresponds to an existing LeaveType by querying the DAO.
